utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: Call the case, please, Madam Registrar.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Good afternoon, Your Honours. This is case number IT-98-34-T, the Prosecutor versus Naletilic and Martinovic.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: Thank you very much. Before we start, are there anything that both parties would like to address to this Trial Chamber?

utterances.speaker: MR. SCOTT
utterances.text: Yes? Doesn't matter to me the order particularly. Mr. President, I don't know what may have been resolved in the last few hours but as you know I brought to the attention of your staff this morning, and to the Defence in fairness to Mr. Seric, because I didn't want him to be surprised by our position and I should also say that we do appreciate the fact that this morning at approximately 9.30 we were faxed a letter indicating an order of three witnesses for this week. On the one hand, I must say I'm glad to have received the notice at 9.30. And that I appreciate. However, the issue and the problems I've raised for the Chamber is that if we understand it correctly, the order of witnesses has been changed in our view somewhat significantly, and we went into the weekend thinking that we were looking at a certain order of witnesses and preparing accordingly and planning our schedules accordingly. And as of 9.30 this morning, the order of witnesses again had changed. As to some of these witnesses -- I'm getting apparently this computer is shutting down, Your Honour. Sorry for the noise.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: I've called someone to come and take care of the matter.

utterances.speaker: MR. SCOTT
utterances.text: As to -- well, perhaps Your Honour it's most efficient just as an abundance of caution we should move into private session in case witness names are mentioned.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: Yes. We go to the private session, please.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: Well, before we have the witness, I must say that during the break, I was reminded that this Chamber has not received a statement of the expert witness in Martinovic's case. Mr. Seric, would you please submit the statement of the expert witness tomorrow? Since we are going to hear that witness next week.

utterances.speaker: MR. PAR
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Mr. President, if I may reply to your question, since I am personally in charge, the statement was submitted two days ago to the Chamber and to the Prosecution some 20 days ago, so two or three days ago, I have received a warning from the secretary of the Chamber that the statement has not been received, and we resubmitted it on Thursday. Can you please check? Because we believe that the statement has been submitted and that it has been submitted to the Prosecution and that it was rather long time ago. And if you would allow me now to say something else with regard to the witnesses? Mr. President, since I was in charge of the list of witnesses, I will say a few words about the situation which has occurred today. The changes were due to the express request of our client, who has changed the order of the witnesses because some of the witnesses decided not to give their testimony, and because he believed that it does -- it makes a difference whether witnesses' statements are taken in this order or in the other. We, as his counsels, have to comply with our clients's request and this is what we did. As soon as this was possible, we informed the Prosecution and the Chamber about the changes. I believe that you will all find it understandable that such things can happen and that this Defence has never abused some of the things arriving from the procedure during this procedure. We have been prepared to allow our learned friends all sorts of concessions, to allow them to prepare for their cross-examination. Today, we have called two witnesses. Can we please move into private session if we are not in private session already? JUDGE LIU: Yes, we are already in private session.

utterances.speaker: MR. PAR
utterances.text: 3.30 p.m., to be reconvened on Tuesday, the 10th day of September, 2002, at 2.15 p.m. 24 25
